scope: Shared ImGui Run/Batch review of captured histogram entries and V4 programs, including explicit targets, output tokens, plots/exact-bin tables, summary Results and optional Run CSV publication. C++ processing/Python processing API and dependencies remain unchanged.
semantics: Histogram entries retain the validated original numeric/log capture and explicitly review destination planes/ranges/positions/ROI, enabled state and unique CSV token. Metadata-only opening is measured separately from renderer sample reads. Existing native workers execute ordered detached stages; preview changes no live results/files. Native Batch uses per-selected-document CSV/session output with current input selection, setup and override paths.
publication: Creator-thread Apply revalidates active source/data dependencies and array destinations, constructs and reserves all histogram summary rows, then publishes optional staged files before the guarded document transaction and nonthrowing result moves. Analysis-only Apply has no undo entry; mixed processing uses one. Running a recorded table does not duplicate recording. Files/analysis rows remain independent of pixel Undo. A later CSV publication conflict preserves the foreign file and any earlier published files, while leaving owner/history/Results unchanged; no retry of an attempted bundle.
presentation: Prepared results show captured count/log plots, unbinned statistics and exact uint64 counts/17-digit edges in a clipped bin table. Result presentation is outside the edit-disabled block, so the exact table remains usable after Apply. Run CSV paths are optional; Browse supports CSV/ROI/ZIP. Batch uses editable per-document CSV filename tokens. Numeric histogram choice authoring within workflows remains open.
cancellation: Queued cancellation, context/draft/source changes and closure discard unpublished results and staged files through the existing workflow epoch/generation, source-revision guards and retained resource ownership. Live navigation remains independent. Running work cancels cooperatively. New queued gate, source-stale and preview input cases prove no publication.
verification: 504 selected Python checks per OS including 18 new input checks; four native executable suites per OS. Independent readers verify 44 reports / 19590 raw input frames, including 36 new histogram workflow reports / 2227 frames. Both launchers cover edited range targets, captured entries, read-only Apply, disabled steps, preview, staged CSV conflict, stale source, queued cancellation and all-document native session batch. Run exercises CSV Browse; Batch edits its output token; read-only Apply expands the exact-bin table after publication. Existing Run/Batch physical reviews and histogram recorder/async/native APIs are rerun. No whole ImageJ/Fiji, original-source/reference, real GPU, OS desktop, wall-time or resource acceptance.
corrections: Initial probe incorrectly combined renderer sample reads with metadata-only admission; final probes isolate zero-read opening before renderer frames. The expanded regression selection exposed an older future-version test that still rejected supported V4; it now rejects V5 while retaining closed-field/Boolean/disabled-step checks. Superseded products and raw captures were archived with CRC and per-member SHA proof before removal.

existing_gate.reason: Existing Auto Contrast consumer producer_source fingerprint mismatch; application.hpp unchanged; no repin or gate relaxation.
